biggest_catch: Very long Election Day (6:00 a.m. to ~9:00 p.m., ~15 hours) for $140-$150.
catches: Election-day only work, not steady employment.
Very long day: 6:00 a.m. to approximately 9:00 p.m. (~15 hours); Judges and Inspectors must work the full day.
Must be a US citizen and registered Delaware County voter; cannot hold public office or be on the ballot (except Judge/Inspector candidates).
County-administered training required; training bonus pay only if you pass the test AND serve successfully on Election Day.
Must be completely non-partisan while serving.

steps: Be a US citizen and registered Delaware County voter.
Complete the poll-worker application to join the Delco Poll Worker database.
Work Election Day approximately 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. (Judges/Inspectors full day; clerks/machine operators may do half-day).
timing: Election-day only; training sessions run September through the Saturday before Election Day.
